AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE AND BIOSECURITY, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR THE COFFEE BERRY BORER AND COFFEE LEAF RUST PESTICIDE SUBSIDY PROGRAM

Allows for the receipt of $150,000 of federally-derived funds to aid coffee growers in Kona and Kaʻū by offsetting the cost of purchasing approved pesticides.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 551-26 & FC-150 - 05/20/26

entry.title: New: Resolution 405 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 405-25 & FC-114 - 01/07/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR FOOD ACCESS SUMMITS

Allows for the receipt of $40,000 of federally-derived funds to plan and facilitate two Food Access Summits that will be used to collect data, support community collaboration, and showcase successful projects.
